{"reason": "v1's 8 shown errors are all truth=demand-forecast-error but v1=unknown: five rows have market-mismatch=#t, others forecast-bias=#t with bias 0.065–0.081 (below the 0.1 threshold). Lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and add market-signal-mismatch? to the forecast branch, converting unknowns into claims (accuracy 0.708, recovery-rate 0.607 should rise).", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
